# proxmox_ha_resources (Data Source)

Lists the high-availability enrolled guests of the cluster from `/cluster/ha/resources`, sorted by HA id. No worker state is queried.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_ha_resources" "all" {}

output "ha_states" {
  value = { for resource in data.proxmox_ha_resources.all.resources : resource.sid => resource.state }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this data source call.
- `resources` (Attributes List) Enrolled HA resources, sorted by `sid`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `auto_rebalance` (Boolean)
- `comment` (String)
- `failback` (Boolean)
- `max_relocate` (Number)
- `max_restart` (Number)
- `sid` (String)
- `state` (String)
